review: Black-and-white geometric kitchen floor, two cats and lower cabinets. Entire visible frame contains no board.
Crop below the dish rack. White recessed sink basin, faucet base and fixed counter edge.
Running water and peppers inside a stainless sink, hands and rim visible. No board.
Plastic slotted draining basket, filled with shredded potatoes. Rim and molded side slots surround the food.
